mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade ( seq, status, created_at, direct_sale_seq, buyer_seq, seller_seq ) VALUES ( trade_seq.NEXTVAL, '확인요청중', SYSDATE, #{directSaleSeq}, #{buyerSeq}, #{sellerSeq} )
mapper.select:
SELECT t.seq, t.status, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.completed_at AS completedAt, t.direct_sale_seq AS directSaleSeq, t.buyer_seq AS buyerSeq, t.seller_seq AS sellerSeq,
d.name AS name, d.product_name AS productName,
bm.nickname AS buyerNickname, sm.nickname AS sellerNickname,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trade_review tr WHERE tr.trade_seq = t.seq AND tr.buyer_seq = #{memberSeq} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hasWritten
FROM trade t
JOIN direct_sale d ON t.direct_sale_seq = d.seq
JOIN member sm ON t.seller_seq = sm.seq
JOIN member bm ON t.buyer_seq = bm.seq
WHERE (t.buyer_seq = #{memberSeq} OR t.seller_seq = #{memberSeq})
AND t.seq < #{lastSeq}
ORDER BY t.seq DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: update direct_sale set status = '완료' WHERE seq = ( SELECT direct_sale_seq FROM trade WHERE seq = #{tradeSeq} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_review ( seq, trade_seq, seller_seq, buyer_seq, score ) VALUES ( trade_review_seq.NEXTVAL, #{tradeSeq}, #{sellerSeq}, #{buyerSeq}, #{score} )
